value.title: Phase 1: Foundations — workspace, ports, drift enforcement, exemplars
value.summary: The mold, decomposed into ordered tasks; each cites its ruling (workshop 001) and AC.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Execute in order; each task's gate must be green before the next starts. Rulings R1-R6 (assets/workshops/001-architecture.md) bind every task; ACs are the contract (plan.dd.md).

value.title: Toolchain pin + repo hygiene: rust-toolchain.toml (stable, rustfmt+clippy), root Cargo.toml workspace with pocs/ exclude, .gitignore for target/. First commit, nothing else in it.
Workspace skeleton: 8 member crates (core,store,tmux,harnesses,transport,daemon,cli->one binary,testkit) compiling empty at hello-world depth; cargo build --workspace green.
Drift gate: arch-allowlist committed with per-row rationale + the test that walks the dep graph; NEGATIVE PROOF recorded (add tokio to core, red, revert; transcript to assets/reports/).

Ports + fakes: the six frozen traits in core/src/ports.rs ('a seventh port is stop-and-ask' comment) + a shipped, deterministic, scriptable fake per port in testkit; fake-as-default config; port contract exemplar test.
Store skeleton: SQLite via sqlx, migration 0001 (WAL+user_version), boot self-migration, stale-schema refusal (skew rule both directions), FreshStore-per-test primitive; store integration exemplar.
Queue primitive: enqueue/claim/ack, dedupe partial-unique over live jobs, per-entity serial keys; contention test with set-equality; mutation-check the dedupe.

Hello-depth binary: pij-rs with two composition roots; daemon serves /health + NDJSON events (Hello line, Unknown variant) on localhost with per-boot 0600 bearer key written before bind; pij-rs ping healthy; first-light transcript captured.

Fixture corpus + exemplars: capture real pij CLI invocations + daemon wire traffic INCLUDING malformed cases into testkit-addressable paths; core unit exemplar (zero doubles); one CLI golden diffed against the TS binary.
Spike lane + shared components: pocs/<name> template ([workspace]+.gitignore+out/), spike gate-posture sentence in README; wire.rs stub; discovery/admission component with shared case table.
Gate + docs: one command running fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, allowlist — all green; README quick-start + architecture doc; fences doc naming shared-merge files.

tk-48f2.assertion: rustc --version == pinned channel exactly (gate stage-1 assert, fail loud); pocs/ excluded in root manifest

tk-5f1d.assertion: cargo build --workspace green; 8 member crates present; core has no tokio/sqlx/HTTP deps

tk-3a93.assertion: allowlist test green AND negative proof recorded (forbidden dep -> red -> revert, transcript in assets/reports/)

tk-ddf1.assertion: SEVEN frozen port traits in ports.rs (R3 as amended) each with a shipped deterministic fake; port contract exemplar green

tk-d4c3.assertion: boot self-migration proven; stale-schema refusal proven BOTH skew directions; FreshStore-per-test primitive used by the store exemplar

tk-f8ff.assertion: dedupe collapses N rapid submits to one row (set-equality contention test); manual mutation evidence on the dedupe predicate

tk-d162.assertion: pij-rs ping healthy over localhost HTTP + bearer key; NDJSON stream carries Hello + survives an unknown event kind; first-light transcript captured

tk-717f.assertion: fixture corpus addressable by name, includes malformed cases; golden MECHANISM proven against captured TS `pij models --json` fixture (Q4 ruling)

tk-388a.assertion: pocs/ template builds standalone; spike gate-posture sentence present; wire.rs stub + admission component with shared case table in gate

tk-81b3.assertion: one-command gate all green; quick-start at crates/README.md; arch doc at assets/architecture.md (Q3 relocation); fences doc names shared-merge files
